component.name: MTV TripSitter
component.summary: Cut video to the beat of your music

description.p: TripSitter analyses a music track, detects its beats (spectral flux, BeatNet and Demucs stem separation via ONNX Runtime, tuned for psytrance and EDM) and cuts one or more videos in time with the music. It offers dynamic cut density, speed ramps with neural frame interpolation, neural upscaling, transitions and beat-driven effects.
